learningObjectives: Explain the core concepts involved in deploying Java applications to the cloud.
Configure application settings using environment variables and external configuration.
Design a deployment workflow that separates development and production environments.

activities.title: Cloud Deployment Architecture
activities.instruction: Explore the major components involved in deploying a Java application.

content.concept: Cloud deployment places an application artifact or container into a managed runtime environment and connects it to required configuration, databases, networking, and external services.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Stores the Java application's source code.
Contains the packaged application or container image prepared for deployment.
Runs the deployed Java application in the cloud environment.
Provides environment-specific values such as URLs, ports, and secrets.
Stores persistent application data when the application requires a database.
Provides the network address through which clients access the application.

activities.title: Configuration Strategy
activities.instruction: Choose the appropriate place for environment-specific configuration.

content.concept: Values that differ between environments should be externalized. Sensitive values such as database credentials should not be hardcoded into source code or committed to version control.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Store production database credentials in the deployment platform's secret or environment configuration
Commit production database passwords directly into application source code
Use one hardcoded database URL for development and production
Store API secrets in a public README file
config.answer: Store production database credentials in the deployment platform's secret or environment configuration

activities.title: Cloud Deployment Pipeline
activities.instruction: Arrange the main stages of a cloud deployment.

content.concept: A deployment workflow prepares a verified application artifact, configures the target environment, starts the application, and verifies that the deployed service is available.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

goal: 1. Build and verify the Java application
2. Create or select the deployable artifact
4. Deploy the artifact to the cloud runtime

activities.title: Environment Configuration Builder
activities.instruction: Build a production configuration without hardcoding secrets.

content.concept: The same application artifact can run in different environments when environment-specific settings are supplied externally.
